svg.title: If either count is zero, e∗= 1/2. At total copy budget B ≥2, the optimal permitted allocation is (1, B −1) or its swap, giving e∗ B = 1/(2 + 2B−1). The minimum worst-case error for identifying the full four-valued label under the same fixed schedule is 2/(2nX + 2nY ) when both counts are positive.
